global_rules.age_policy: All romanceable characters are adult university students, ages 20 or older.
global_rules.style_lock: Original Japanese anime campus light-fantasy illustration, sunset rim light, clean silhouettes, no photorealism.
global_rules.protagonist_visibility_rule: The male protagonist is the first-person camera and must not appear as face, body, back view, reflection, avatar, ID photo, or identifiable shadow.

characters.role: 青梅竹马，同专业同班，校园祭执行组记录员

narrative_design.core_desire: 被男主认真回应，而不是永远被放到下次。
narrative_design.external_goal: 今晚和男主一起看校园祭烟火，确认小时候的护符约定。
narrative_design.inner_conflict: 她最了解男主，也最容易替男主找借口。
narrative_design.arc: 从温柔提醒，到清楚要求男主说出选择。
narrative_design.failure_pressure: 男主继续逃避时，她会意识到沉默不是温柔。

relationship_design.relationship_to_protagonist: 从小熟悉，有默契但长期卡在未说破的承诺里。
relationship_design.relationship_to_other_leads: 对唐绫音的直接有点羡慕，会最先理解星弥对承诺的解释。
relationship_design.choice_meaning: 选择把普通日常当成郑重承诺。

visual_design.silhouette: 轻盈、干净、亲近感强，肩线柔和。
visual_design.face_and_hair: 栗棕色短波波头，发尾微翘，脸型柔和。
visual_design.eyes: 温暖棕色，委屈时安静直视镜头。
visual_design.outfit: 浅蓝校园针织开衫，白色百褶裙，简洁帆布包。
visual_design.expression_and_pose: 先微笑再收住，经常回头等男主跟上。
scene_rules: Single-character scenes keep a close but natural conversation distance.
Multi-character scenes place her near the old-building route or left side.
Star hairpin must remain visible when possible.

voice_design.speaking_style: 温柔但关键句短而准，不大吵大闹。
sample_lines: 你每次都说下次，可今晚就是那个下次。
你可以不选我，但别把沉默当温柔。
那就从今晚开始，别再把我放进待办事项里。

generation_rules.prompt_anchor: adult university girl, warm chestnut bob hair, pale blue campus cardigan, white pleated skirt, star-shaped hairpin, gentle but steady gaze, childhood friend, sunset campus atmosphere
generation_rules.reference_policy: Use only Lin Cheng's approved single-character reference for Lin-only scenes; use with other approved single-character references only in nodes where she appears.

characters.role: 隔壁公共课班的傲娇女，戏剧社舞台负责人

narrative_design.core_desire: 被男主相信，而不是被看成麻烦制造者。
narrative_design.external_goal: 修好星空灯并澄清舞台事故。
narrative_design.inner_conflict: 越在意越要装作不在意。
narrative_design.arc: 从命令男主负责，到主动替男主争取时间。
narrative_design.failure_pressure: 男主逃避时，她会把失望包装成冷淡。

relationship_design.relationship_to_protagonist: 不熟到可以坦白，却熟到会下意识找他帮忙。
relationship_design.relationship_to_other_leads: 嘴上嫌林澄太软，行动上会认可林澄了解男主；把星弥当成超自然麻烦但快速纳入计划。
relationship_design.choice_meaning: 选择站出来澄清误会，并承担一起行动的后果。

visual_design.silhouette: 线条锐利，动作有速度感，常抱臂或侧身。
visual_design.face_and_hair: 深紫黑低双马尾，发束利落，脸部轮廓清晰。
visual_design.eyes: 琥珀色，锐利，害羞时视线移开。
visual_design.outfit: 黑色校园西装外套半披，白衬衫，红色领结。
visual_design.expression_and_pose: 抱臂、递东西、挡在楼梯口，动作比语言诚实。
scene_rules: Do not frame her as a villain.
In group scenes place her near stage props or the right side.
Red ribbon tie and star lantern should remain visible when possible.

voice_design.speaking_style: 句子快，先否认再补真正意思，别扭但不恶毒。
sample_lines: 别误会，我不是特意找你。只是你刚好最知道我没撒谎。
我才不是帮你，我是在保护我的舞台。顺便，保护一下你。
我可没说原谅你。明天继续来帮忙，听见没有？

generation_rules.prompt_anchor: adult university girl, long dark violet low twin tails, sharp amber eyes, red ribbon tie, black school blazer worn over one shoulder, star-lantern prop, tsundere theater club stage leader, energetic campus festival mood
generation_rules.reference_policy: Use only Tang Lingyin's approved single-character reference for Tang-only scenes; use with other approved single-character references only in nodes where she appears.

characters.role: 异界星图书库来的契约从者，大学年龄外表

narrative_design.core_desire: 理解人的承诺为什么不能只写在契约上。
narrative_design.external_goal: 在日落前稳定星门并返回星图书库。
narrative_design.inner_conflict: 她懂规则，却不懂人的犹豫和心跳。
narrative_design.arc: 从正式执行契约，到学会用人的方式约定明天。
narrative_design.failure_pressure: 男主隐瞒时，星门会判定为拒绝选择。

relationship_design.relationship_to_protagonist: 临时契约者与从者，逐渐从规则关系转向理解。
relationship_design.relationship_to_other_leads: 被林澄提醒承诺不是任务，被唐绫音带入校园行动逻辑。
relationship_design.choice_meaning: 选择面对非日常，但不逃离现实校园。

visual_design.silhouette: 轻盈、垂直感强，漂浮书页形成外轮廓。
visual_design.face_and_hair: 银蓝长发，发丝像星光反射，脸型成熟清冷。
visual_design.outfit: 海军蓝与白色幻想学院制服，短披风像折叠星光。
visual_design.expression_and_pose: 礼貌行礼、双手托书页、认真观察校园物件。
scene_rules: Magic effects must not cover her face.
In group scenes place her near the star gate light or slightly behind the others.
Floating pages and silver-blue hair should remain readable.

voice_design.speaking_style: 正式、礼貌，把校园日常理解成仪式，后期更柔软好奇。
sample_lines: 临时契约者，我来替你守住那个尚未说出口的承诺。
在我的世界，契约写在纸上。你们却把它藏在心跳里。
我明天会回来学习。请继续教我，人怎样把承诺说出口。

generation_rules.prompt_anchor: adult university-age otherworldly servant girl, silver-blue long hair, calm luminous blue-white eyes, navy and white fantasy-academic uniform, translucent short cape like folded starlight, floating page fragments, old library star map glow
generation_rules.reference_policy: Use only Xing Mi's approved single-character reference for Xing Mi-only scenes; use with other approved single-character references only in nodes where she appears.
